MasulloTrace.geometric_diagonal.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (φ : Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0)
  (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K) : geometricKernel K φ S x x = -S x x
'MasulloTrace.geometric_diagonal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloTrace.cutoff_diagonal_mass.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)]
  (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (φ : Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (ρ : Classes K → ℂ) :
  ∫ (x : Classes K), ρ x * geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ = -∫ (x : Classes K), ρ x * S x x ∂μ

MasulloTrace.cutoff_geometric_mass_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)]
  (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (φ : Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ)
  (hS : Integrable (fun x => S x x) μ) (ρ : ℕ → Classes K → ℂ) (hρmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ)
  (hρbound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1)
  (hρlim : ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => ρ n x) atTop (nhds 1)) :
  Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : Classes K), ρ n x * geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ) atTop (nhds (-∫ (x : Classes K), S x x ∂μ))

MasulloTrace.geometric_action_after_projection.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (φ f : Classes K → ℂ)
  (P : (Classes K → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Classes K → ℂ) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K)
  (hf : Integrable (fun y => convolutionKernel K φ x y * f y) μ)
  (hPf : Integrable (fun y => convolutionKernel K φ x y * P f y) μ) (hSf : Integrable (fun y => S x y * f y) μ)
  (hrep : ∫ (y : Classes K), S x y * f y ∂μ = kernelConvolution K μ φ (P f) x) :
  ∫ (y : Classes K), geometricKernel K φ S x y * f y ∂μ = kernelConvolution K μ φ (f - P f) x

  (hbound : ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ 1) : Integrable (fun x => ρ x * geometricKernel K φ S x x) μ

MasulloTrace.kernelConvolution_eq_leftConvolution.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] [MeasurableMul (Classes K)] [MeasurableInv (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K))
  [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [μ.IsInvInvariant] (φ f : Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K) :
  kernelConvolution K μ φ f x = ∫ (g : Classes K), φ g * f (g⁻¹ * x) ∂μ

MasulloTrace.kernelConvolution_integrable.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)]
  [MeasurableMul (Classes K)] [MeasurableInv (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [μ.IsInvInvariant] (φ f : Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K) (hf : Integrable (fun g => φ g * f (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) :
  Integrable (fun y => convolutionKernel K φ x y * f y) μ

MasulloTrace.truncated_geometric_left_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] [MeasurableMul (Classes K)] [MeasurableInv (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K))
  [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [μ.IsInvInvariant] (φ f ρ : Classes K → ℂ) (P : (Classes K → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Classes K → ℂ)
  (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K) (hf : Integrable (fun g => φ g * f (g⁻¹ * x)) μ)
  (hPf : Integrable (fun g => φ g * P f (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) (hSf : Integrable (fun y => S x y * f y) μ)
  (hrep : ∫ (y : Classes K), S x y * f y ∂μ = ∫ (g : Classes K), φ g * P f (g⁻¹ * x) ∂μ) :
  Integrable (fun y => ρ x * (geometricKernel K φ S x y * f y)) μ ∧
    ∫ (y : Classes K), ρ x * (geometricKernel K φ S x y * f y) ∂μ =
      ρ x * ∫ (g : Classes K), φ g * (f - P f) (g⁻¹ * x) ∂μ

MasulloTrace.weighted_geometric_kernel_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (w : Classes K → NNReal) (hw : Measurable w)
  (hwpos : ∀ (y : Classes K), 0 < ↑(w y)) (φ f : Classes K → ℂ) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (x : Classes K) :
  (∫ (y : Classes K), (↑(w y))⁻¹ • geometricKernel K φ S x y * f y ∂μ.withDensity fun y => ↑(w y)) =
    ∫ (y : Classes K), geometricKernel K φ S x y * f y ∂μ

MasulloTrace.weighted_geometric_cutoff_mass.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)]
  (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (w : Classes K → NNReal) (hw : Measurable w) (hwpos : ∀ (y : Classes K), 0 < ↑(w y))
  (φ ρ : Classes K → ℂ) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) :
  (∫ (x : Classes K), ρ x * (↑(w x))⁻¹ • geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ.withDensity fun x => ↑(w x)) =
    ∫ (x : Classes K), ρ x * geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ

  (hwpos : ∀ (y : Classes K), 0 < ↑(w y)) (φ : Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0) (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ)
  (hS : Integrable (fun x => S x x) μ) (ρ : ℕ → Classes K → ℂ) (hρmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ)
  (hρbound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1)

MasulloTrace.weighted_geometric_cutoff_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloTrace.Classes K)] (μ : Measure (MasulloTrace.Classes K))
  (w : MasulloTrace.Classes K → NNReal) (hw : Measurable w) (hwpos : ∀ (y : MasulloTrace.Classes K), 0 < ↑(w y))
  (φ : MasulloTrace.Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0) (S : MasulloTrace.Classes K → MasulloTrace.Classes K → ℂ)
  (hS : Integrable (fun x => S x x) μ) (ρ : ℕ → MasulloTrace.Classes K → ℂ)
  (hρmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ)
  (hρbound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : MasulloTrace.Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1)
  (hρlim : ∀ᵐ (x : MasulloTrace.Classes K) ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => ρ n x) atTop (nhds 1)) :
  Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      ∫ (x : MasulloTrace.Classes K),
        ρ n x * (↑(w x))⁻¹ • MasulloTrace.geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ.withDensity fun x => ↑(w x))
    atTop (nhds (-∫ (x : MasulloTrace.Classes K), S x x ∂μ))
